classifications.rationale: The President explains his present withholding of approval from S. 1128 in a veto communication; this is not presidential governance over agencies or legal rights under the codebook.
classifications.evidence: For these reasons, I cannot approve S. 1128.

classifications.evidence: My administration will work closely with the next Congress to pass acceptable legislation.
